# quirc provenance

The sources in this directory are vendored from `dlbeer/quirc`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/dlbeer/quirc
- Pinned commit: `927d680904dc95fdff4cd9d022eb374b438ff8f2`
- Imported files: `decode.c`, `identify.c`, `quirc.c`, `quirc.h`, `quirc_internal.h`, `version_db.c`
- License: ISC-style permission notice reproduced in every imported source file.
- Local modifications: none.

When updating, replace all six files together from one upstream commit and rerun the QR generate/decode Release smoke tests.
